description.button: Button component configuration array. Accepts all standard button parameters (text, icon, size, color, style, shape, etc.). Merged directly into the trigger button.
description.placeholder: Placeholder text inside the search input.
description.inputName: Name attribute for the search input (used in query string).
description.inputLabel: Accessible label for the search input.
description.action: Form action URL. Defaults to current page.
description.method: Form submission method; get or post.
description.closeLabel: Accessible label for the close button.
description.isExpanded: Render the component in its expanded state on load.
